whyItMatters: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a pod resolved from a directory on the build machine.
actions: Depend on a published, versioned artifact, and keep local paths or branch references out of the committed manifest. Specifically: fix a pod resolved from a directory on the build machine.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm Podfile no longer carries a pod resolved from a directory on the build machine.
